subject: select2 and a large (12,000) selection list

messages.author: 6bd89b1e00d3f8c7
messages.subject: select2 and a large (12,000) selection list
parts:
Hi,

I need some guidance, please. I have list of 12,000 gene symbols on the server side of my application. I wanted to provide my user with select2-type behavior whereby, as the user types a character, suggested symbols are presented in the selection list. 

I tried the naive approach: I simply made the gene list the value of a select2 selection list. This works for around 500 symbols but does not work for 12,000 - there is no response from the server after several minutes. This behavior is understandable. 

So, it seems that I might need an approach that employs a dialog between the ui and the server - narrowing down the list on the server side as the user types in characters. What I need some help with is the approach I should take. Should I use websockets or is there some combination of observe() and updateSelectInput that might work. I would like to retain the select2 functionality that allows the user to accumulate selections, that is, let the user select more than one gene symbol.

Thanks very much,

Peter

messages.author: 6bd89b1e00d3f8c7
messages.subject: Re: select2 and a large (12,000) selection list
parts:
OK. I think I found the way to do this: use the ajax feature in select2. Plus websockets (R package) on the server side

If I can get this all to work, I'll post the code.


Peter

messages.author: fa8b9dad524607ca
messages.subject: Re: select2 and a large (12,000) selection list
parts:
I had a similar issue, but my solution was a bit different- I created a search function of sorts, and then take their selection to use further.  This stuff was written before the shiny server had an updateUI function (I believe that is what is was called? maybe refreshUI? Oh well, in any event...)
### ui.R portion ###

checkboxInput("findGeneTopcheck", "Search for a Gene Symbol? (optional)"),
uiOutput("choose_geneTop1"),
uiOutput("choose_geneTop2")

### server.R portion ###
        output$choose_geneTop1 <- renderUI({
    conditionalPanel(
  condition = "input.findGeneTopcheck == true",
  textInput("findGeneTop", "Search for a Gene Symbol", "")
)
      
})
  output$choose_geneTop2 <- renderUI({

     if(is.null(tlist())) # tlist is a matrix that I wish to subset, eventually, and has the symbols in it
 return()
      if(is.null(topgeneinput()))
 return()
 tlist1=tlist()
   
    testl=unique(as.character(tlist1[,'sym'])) # get a vector of the gene symbols
    setsg=testl[grep(topgeneinput(),testl,ignore.case=TRUE)] # use grep to search and subset
    if(length(setsg)>500){ #if it's too big, take the first 500, they will be more specific if need be
    setsg=setsg[1:500]
    }
    #
    conditionalPanel( #make the UI
  condition = "input.findGeneTopcheck == true",
   selectInput("topselectedG", "Select the Gene Symbol",
              as.list(setsg))
             
)     
})
